elevators (Gate 5, Stadium Club), escalators (Gates 3 and 5, 100/300/500), Gate 5 ramps, compass (official access guide and Ballpark Guide A-Z, 2026)

address (333 W 35th St), Dan Ryan Expressway on the east side

name: Rate Field
disclaimer: Unofficial, not affiliated with Rate Field or the Chicago White Sox.

levels.name: 100 Level
unverified: the concourse is assumed to run all the way around behind the Fan Deck in center field
106 and 107 aren't seats on the chart (Patio, Miller Lite Landing, Leinenkugel's Craft Lodge); they're kept as spots because the concessions list uses them
sections are spaced evenly; on the chart the corner sections are a little wider

levels.name: 300 Club Level
unverified: only the sections labeled on the chart are listed (mostly even numbers); there may be odd-numbered sections too
the concourse is assumed to run end to end, behind the Rate Club, from the right-field corner (Stadium Club) to left field (by 357)
330 and 334 sit on either side of the Rate Club, which isn't modeled, so they're drawn closer together than they are

levels.name: 500 Level
unverified: the concourse is assumed to run end to end, from 506 in the right-field corner to 558 in left field, with no path behind the outfield
there's no 532 on the chart (531 and 533 sit either side of the line behind home plate)

gates.name: Gate 4

gates.name: Gate 5
unverified: the chart's label is in left field, the guide says the north side (35th St), and the Gate 5 ramps are 'near sections 137, 334 or 536'; the spot is a compromise
the ramps are modeled as one ramp linking 100, 300 and 500
official: elevators at Gate 5 reach the levels; which ones exactly isn't stated
official: Stadium Club elevators, for Stadium Club members and guests with disabilities, reach the 100 Level and the 300 Level
